snippet.title: Go Forward Survivors Trailer
snippet.description:
This is an action roguelike game. At its core, the gameplay is driven by a freely configurable skill system, combined with over 20 core attributes, allowing you to construct your ultimate Build.

Steam Link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3519700?utm_source=youtobe
